title: We are building an AI-powered platform for game creators
author: gamewise-ai
selftext:
Hi all!

We are building an AI-powered platform to support game creators throughout the entire development journey.

Instead of jumping between different tools, the platform aims to bring key parts of the process into one place, helping developers structure their ideas, make better design decisions, and get AI-powered guidance along the way.

Currently, we’re about to start the first user tests.

If you’re interested in testing the platform and helping us shape it, drop a comment, and I'll share the request form.

In this early version, testers will be able to explore things like:

• shaping and validating game ideas  
• experimenting in an AI-powered game design playground  
• getting detailed player feedback analysis for launched games  
• receiving data-driven insights during the development process

Your feedback will directly influence how it evolves!

Thank you!!!

replies.author: gamewise-ai
replies.body:
Is there another tool that implements the features I mentioned above on a single platform? please be specific. I'm not asking to start a debate; I'm genuinely curious. 
You will be able to test the features I listed above during the demo test phase. To explain briefly: after you enter your draft game idea into the system, our platform diversifies it according to its genre, develops the idea, filters the competitor games most similar to your game in the market, and reviews the feedback made about these games to offer you suggestions. There is also a design playground where you can shape your game with AI. 
After testing, a feature will be available that allows you to instantly analyze your game's competitors' marketing efforts. We will provide marketing strategies and calendars specifically integrated for the game you are developing. There are also features we want to develop or add based on test feedback. 

Important note: We do not generate code blocks or creative assets. 

Thanks.

comments.author: moneydollarz
comments.body: I’m noticing that there’s no website, no public social media, and nothing that shows who you or your team actually are. It’s hard to feel comfortable signing up for a beta when there’s no verifiable information about the people behind the platform. Without transparency, testers end up feeling like test subjects for something completely unknown. Before anyone joins, it would really help to see some proof of who you are and what you’ve built so far. Not to mention you want us to test this platform for free.....
